info.x-fragment-description: ADR-037 register fragment for the appointment confirmation flow. Declares the Appointment and ConfirmationToken schemas plus their lifecycle state machines and demo seed objects, without editing shillinq_register.json.

Appointment.title: Appointment
Appointment.description: A bookable appointment between a customer (a Nextcloud contact) and a service provider. Self-booked appointments start in pending_confirmation and must be confirmed by the customer via a ConfirmationToken before the deadline, after which they auto-cancel. Admin-created appointments start confirmed and skip the confirmation flow (REQ-BCF-010).

contactId.description: Reference to the customer as a Nextcloud contact (addressbook-synced contact identifier). A customer is always a Nextcloud entity per the fleet contact convention — never an app-local person schema.

customerEmail.description: Customer email used to deliver the confirmation message; resolved from the contact where available.

customerTimezone.description: IANA timezone name used for ICS TZID/VTIMEZONE and email local-time display (REQ-BCF-009). Falls back to the server default when unset.

serviceName.description: Name of the booked service, used as the ICS SUMMARY.

providerName.description: Name of the service provider rendering the appointment.

location.description: Physical or virtual location, used as the ICS LOCATION.

notes.description: Free-form appointment notes, used as the ICS DESCRIPTION.

confirmationDeadline.description: CHANGED (REQ-BCF-004): latest moment the customer may confirm before the appointment auto-cancels (REQ-BCF-005).

confirmedAt.description: CHANGED (REQ-BCF-004): timestamp the appointment moved from pending_confirmation to confirmed.

confirmationTokenId.description: CHANGED (REQ-BCF-004): reference to the current valid ConfirmationToken record.

cancelledReason.description: Reason recorded when the appointment is cancelled (e.g. 'Confirmation deadline passed').

administrationId.description: Tenant administration identifier, used to scope reads and writes per IDOR-safety.

pending_confirmation.label: Pending confirmation
pending_confirmation.description: Customer self-booked; awaiting confirmation via the ConfirmationToken before the deadline.

confirmed.label: Confirmed
confirmed.description: Customer confirmed attendance; the appointment is active.

cancelled.label: Cancelled
cancelled.description: The appointment was cancelled manually or auto-cancelled after the confirmation deadline passed.

appointment_confirmed.label: Confirm appointment
appointment_confirmed.description: Guarded by ConfirmationToken validation. Invoked by ConfirmationApiController::confirm (REQ-BCF-004).

appointment_auto_cancelled.label: Auto-cancel on deadline
appointment_auto_cancelled.description: The deadline passed without confirmation; cancelled by CancelUnconfirmedAppointments (REQ-BCF-005).

appointment_cancelled.label: Cancel appointment
appointment_cancelled.description: Manual cancellation of a confirmed appointment.

appointment_completed.label: Complete appointment
appointment_completed.description: The appointment took place and is marked completed.

ConfirmationToken.title: Confirmation Token
ConfirmationToken.description: A single-use, time-limited token authorising a customer to confirm a pending appointment via an email link or web portal (REQ-BCF-001/002). The raw token string is never stored — only a bcrypt hash — and is excluded from API reads. Resends revoke the prior token and issue a fresh one (REQ-BCF-006).

appointmentId.description: Reference to the Appointment being confirmed (FK).

tokenString.description: Bcrypt hash of the 32-character URL-safe token. The raw token is delivered to the customer once and never persisted; this field is masked on API reads (REQ-BCF-002).

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC token expiry (typically +7 days from creation).

redeemedAt.description: Timestamp the token was redeemed to confirm the appointment.

createdBy.description: User id that triggered creation; 'system' for auto-generated tokens.

administrationId.description: Tenant administration identifier copied from the appointment, used to scope reads per IDOR-safety.

active.label: Active
active.description: Token may be redeemed to confirm the appointment until it expires.

redeemed.label: Redeemed
redeemed.description: Token was used to confirm the appointment and cannot be reused.

revoked.label: Revoked
revoked.description: Token was invalidated by a resend request.

expired.label: Expired
expired.description: Token passed its expiresAt and is no longer valid.

token_revoked.label: Revoke token
token_revoked.description: A resend request invalidated this token (REQ-BCF-006).
